Help Center

What is Photizo Studio?

A photo and video studio for creators, with templates, Pleroma AI reviews, a curated library, and a community.

Where are my projects saved?

On this device, in Projects. Cloud storage with Photizo Space comes with accounts.

What does Pleroma AI do?

It reviews your photo, suggests fixes, and recommends scriptures that match your theme. This preview runs simple checks in your browser.

Can I remove a photo background?

Not yet. It needs an AI service that comes with the live backend. Your photos are never changed without you choosing to edit them.

How do plans work?

Spark is free. Radiant and Lambent Diamond add more AI reviews, Sophia Library, and fewer ads. See Plans for details.

Questions? Email ejisalem6@gmail.com. Full Terms and Conditions publish before launch.
